scope.source_publication_rule: Occurrence, publication, collection and evidence horizon are independent; date-only or subsequently updated reports do not prove event occurrence within window.

new_events.actor: Iran Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei, written statement attributed to his office
new_events.summary: Iranian leadership publicly ordered readiness for immediate response without geographic limits to renewed attacks and an updated target list including US and Israeli physical and nonphysical assets. State media described a meeting with top commanders, but Khamenei has not been independently photographed in public; treat meeting as state-reported. No independently established launch order, troop movement, targeting coordinates or executed attack.

geospatial.source_location_description: Iran national military policy; reported commanders meeting in Tehran not an authenticated troop movement
geospatial.uncertainty_note: No physical strike point or movement independently established.

new_events.summary: Coalition spokesman said a hostile drone was intercepted over Riyadh Region; fragments fell without reported injuries and authorities were inspecting debris. Spokesman did not independently identify operator or launch point in this specific announcement. Separate from Oct30 Eastern/Southern and Medina/Makkah claims; do not infer precise Riyadh city impact or Houthi responsibility.

geospatial.source_location_description: Riyadh Region, Saudi Arabia; debris location not disclosed
geospatial.uncertainty_note: No authenticated exact coordinates or canonical point identity; prohibit point projection.

new_events.actor: Jordan Armed Forces border guards and unidentified armed crossers
new_events.summary: Jordanian military reported 14 armed people attempting to cross from Syria into northern Jordan on Friday, engagement under fire and unspecified casualties among the group; remainder fled into Syria. Nationality, organizational affiliation, precise border sector, casualty count and independent confirmation unavailable. New Saturday disclosure of Friday occurrence, not a Saturday firefight.

Separate from previously announced Oct30–Nov3 northwest Kuwait exercise. This is advance notice, not evidence exercises began, troop deployment or any combat incident.

existing_event_updates.summary: Iranian envoys held talks with Qatari mediators in Doha following more than 12 hours of Tehran talks Friday. Qatar in regular contact with Washington. Foreign Minister Araghchi said a mediator proposal could shorten conditional Hormuz reopening to two days (from seven), while Iran reviewed nuclear proposals and Vance letter but did not plan direct US meetings. Reuters reported Qatar's seven-day trust-building sequence rejected as unsatisfactory. No US acceptance, sanctions waiver, signed deal, Hormuz reopening or IAEA inspection implemented.
